modules.title: Introduction to Drug Abuse and Trafficking
modules.html:
Causes and effects of drug abuse, prevention, and the work of the NDLEA. This section covers introduction to drug abuse and trafficking.

Key points

  • The government agency responsible for the prevention of drug abuse and trafficking in Nigeria is the _____. — NDLEA.
  • The government agency responsible for the prevention of drug abuse and trafficking in Nigeria is _____. — NDLEA.
  • The primary motive for drug trafficking is _____. — Greed for quick money.
  • Which of the following is a way to reduce drug abuse among youths — Providing drug education and counseling.
  • Drug Abuse effect: — Madness/Health issues.

Worked examples

Q: The government agency responsible for the prevention of drug abuse and trafficking in Nigeria is the _____.
A: NDLEA — The National Drug Law Enforcement Agency (NDLEA) is a Nigerian federal agency established to eliminate the growing, processing, manufacturing, selling, exporting, and trafficking of hard drugs.

Q: The government agency responsible for the prevention of drug abuse and trafficking in Nigeria is _____.
A: NDLEA — The National Drug Law Enforcement Agency (NDLEA) is specifically tasked with eliminating the growing, processing, selling, and trafficking of hard drugs.

examples.q: The government agency responsible for the prevention of drug abuse and trafficking in Nigeria is the _____.
The government agency responsible for the prevention of drug abuse and trafficking in Nigeria is _____.
